# contract-testing

Provider/consumer contract testing and property-based boundary fuzzing - Pact and Schemathesis are the tools the TESTING rules measure reports from.

## Recipes

- `apiforge diff contract --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show contract-testing`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-TEST-001, AF-TEST-002, AF-TEST-007, AF-TEST-102
